android.desc:
Collecting useful snips of information is hard on the go
- VoiceNotes allows you to record a voice note ⏺️
- VoiceNotes transcribes your voice🔤
- VoiceNotes records the location  and time as well  📍⌚
- VoiceNotes enables you to go through all the voice notes later at a convenient time
- VoiceNotes works offline, so, no data connection is required to use it
- VoiceNotes allows you to see the location of all the notes on a map

For those who keep thinking of new ideas, concepts, or jokes, VoiceNotes allow you to jot them down before you lose that ephemeral stream of thought. You can share the recording or the text message in other apps later. It is great for taking quick notes while listening to audiobooks.

Forget WhatsApp voice memos.
Vocenotes is the fastest player in town.

Note: on Android 12 and later, Google's on-device transcription does not work. So, a new offline transcription model has been added. This new model is English-only.

#Author #MovieMaker #TravelBlogging #IdeaGenerator #Incident #Reporter #AudioBooks #Doctors

quotes.text: I built a similar product for myself sometimes back - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.ashishb.voicenotes (Android only)
